title: Data Engineer
summary: Data Engineer with nearly 4 years of experience building automated data pipelines and scalable data infrastructure. Demonstrated ability to design end-to-end data workflows — from raw data ingestion (PostgreSQL, MySQL) through multi-table integration, feature engineering, and automated processing. Skilled in consolidating multi-source data (MySQL, PostgreSQL, APIs) into unified analytics infrastructure and maintaining data quality across all pipeline outputs. Proficient in Python-based pipeline automation using Pandas, SQLAlchemy, and database integration.

tailored_bullets: Designed and automated end-to-end data pipelines using Python (Pandas, SQLAlchemy) — from PostgreSQL ingestion to multi-table integration and automated processing
Consolidated multi-source data (MySQL, PostgreSQL, APIs) into unified analytics infrastructure
Applied feature engineering techniques (temporal feature extraction, date deltas, categorical encoding, business aggregations) to enrich datasets for analytical use
Conducted data quality assurance including missing value detection, outlier identification, and distribution analysis
Collaborated cross-functionally to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions

experiences.position_title: IT Applications Manager / Data & Backend Developer
tailored_bullets: Integrated third-party APIs and databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) to deliver scalable data tracking solutions
Performed end-to-end data processing, modeling, and quality assurance to support project delivery decisions
Conducted data quality assurance and pipeline optimization, maintaining integrity across all data outputs
Delivered custom data solutions for platforms serving 50+ concurrent users

key_project.title: DataSphere360 — E-commerce Customer Intelligence System
bullets: Built a fully automated, reusable data pipeline framework in Python covering: PostgreSQL data ingestion → automated cleaning (missing values, duplicates, datetime conversion) → multi-table integration (9 tables, 112,650 rows, auto FK/PK detection)

Engineered 81 features automatically: temporal extraction (year/month/weekday/weekend), 15 date-delta calculations, one-hot encoding — plus 5 business features (total order value, delivery time, items per order, customer frequency, customer LTV)
Designed framework architecture with stub pattern — pipeline runs end-to-end at any stage of completion, enabling iterative improvement without rework
